description: Contextual information about a web service call.

sessionId.description: Each web service request is issue a unique session ID (UUID) that is included in the call's access recored.  Events that are triggered by a web service request should include the session ID so that they can be linked to each other and the call's access record.

identityProvider.description: The name of the identity provider that authenticated the caller, either SYNAPSE or an OAuthProvider, taken from the access token presented with the request. Absent when nothing authenticated the caller.
